newsitem.title: USA: US corp bonds ride Treasuries, stocks to firm close.
newsitem.headline: US corp bonds ride Treasuries, stocks to firm close.

text.p: Rallying stock and Treasury markets warmed both investment grade and high-yield U.S. corporate debt Thursday, pushing both to a higher close.
Spreads on most investment-grade corporate bonds tightened by roughly one basis point, while prices on high-yield bonds rose by 1/4 to 3/8 of a point, traders said.
Among investment grades, bank and finance company trust preferred stock tightened by three to five basis points, pushed by insurance company and money manager buying.
Traders noted the sector has tightened by a total of eight to 12 basis points since the beginning of the week.
